newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end little changed, no sellers.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end little changed, no sellers.

text.p: Sri Lankan shares closed flat in dull trade on Monday with big buyers sidelined by a lack of sellers, brokers said.
The Colombo Stock Exchange all share index closed 0.07 points lower at 556.30. Lanka Walltile fell 1.25 rupees to 28 and Ceylon Cold Stores two to 68.
"Only cheap shares were traded because they were the only ones available," said Ajit Wanigasekera of Commercial Stock Brokers.
Brokres said even low priced shares were not available in quantities sufficient to attract institutional investors.
"Sellers are holding back because the index seems to have firm support at 550," said Shanil Perera of Lanka Securities.

Turnover was 3.88 million rupees, with 249,460 shares changing hands. Volume was supported by 24,900 shares of Associated Electricals, 25,300 Distilleries shares, 49,400 Mahaweli Reach Hotel shares and 17,400 Vanik shares.

Investors were watching Hapugastenne Plantations Ltd, an estate firm being sold by the government as part of its privatisation exercise, brokers said. Bids for a 51 percent stake, or 10.2 million 10-rupee shares, in the company close tomorrow.
